name: airbrake_projects
title: Read Airbrake projects
description: Airbrake projects: list, get, list_activities (audit log). Project updates are intentionally NOT modeled here — the /api/v4/projects/:id update endpoint requires dashboard-session credentials, not Personal API tokens, and returns 401 for all tokens our MCP supports. Use the Airbrake dashboard to change project settings. List results include `_pagination.has_more`/`next_page`. Returns the raw Airbrake JSON payload — no data is removed unless list/list_activities is given `fields` (keeps only those top-level keys per item).

fields.description: List actions only: keep just these top-level keys (exact names as Airbrake returns them, e.g. ["id","createdAt"]) on each listed item. Omit for the full payload.
